newsitem.title: USA: Alpine Lace hires Merrill to explore sale.
newsitem.headline: Alpine Lace hires Merrill to explore sale.

text.p: Alpine Lace Brands Inc said it has hired Merill Lynch & Co to explore several strategic initiatives to enhance shareholder value, including the possible sale of the marketer of cheeses and deli meats.

"Alpine Lace's strong results in the first six months of 1997 reflect the positive impact of the actions the company has taken in the past year to improve performance," said Carl Wolf, chairman and CEO. "It is therefore an opportune time to investigate avenues to increase shareholder value."
Alpine Lace makes reduced-fat and/or sodium-and fat-free cheeses and reduced-fat and fat-free delicatessen meats.
